title: Temporal and sentiment analysis of alcohol-related tweets in Thailand during 2023: patterns and trends in online discourse
core_idea: To characterize temporal patterns and sentiment of Thai-language alcohol-related tweets collected in early 2023 by using keyword-based data collection and manual coding of a random sample to categorize tweet types and content.
tldr: Large-scale collection and manual coding of Thai-language alcohol-related tweets to examine temporal trends, sentiment, and content patterns in online discourse during 2023.
